notes.subject: שבעי שבעות
notes.rationale: KJV 'weeks upon weeks' vs JPS 'sworn oaths' — pes bilong שבע (bet/swear) i pilai long tok; mi usim 'tupela bet, tripela bet' olsem pasin Hibru bilong tok planti taim

notes.subject: שבעי שבעות
notes.rationale: Tupela tok i wankain rot: bet (seven) na bet (swear) — olsem 'teti fold' long Tok Pisin i no ken holim olgeta mining

notes.subject: להתפש
notes.rationale: Heb 'to be seized/captured' — mi tanim 'kisim' bilong ol i ken holim ol

translation: Na em bai i kamap long ol olsem kalka bilong tok gutpela tumas, sapos em i nogut long ai bilong ol, tupela bet, tripela bet long ol; tasol em i bringim bek ⟨i⟩ tingting bilong rong bilong ol, bilong ol i ken kisim

tokens.gloss: olsem kalka bilong tok gutpela tumas, sapos em i nogut
